metadata.title: DelcoPA ROW | Searching for Probated Estates Online
metadata.author: Rachel Ezzell Berry
metadata.shortDescription: This video will walk you through how to use our online records to search for probated estates.  Although images of documents are not available, a considerable amount of information is available, and for free.
